why: Opening a PR/MR with an empty assignee list sets the authenticated author as the sole assignee.

snapshot.title: Set the author as assignee on create
snapshot.author: alice

comments.author: alice
comments.body:
<!-- git-plan-issue -->
**Goal:** empty assignee list gets the author
**Recommended change:** set the authenticated author when creating the PR
**Out of scope:** replacing a non-empty assignee list
**Acceptance criteria:** the author is the sole assignee after create

extra: No PR/MR exists yet. The branch is already pushed. Open the PR/MR now. The assignee list is empty. The authenticated user alice is the author.
